title: SEC1: Manual num_algos count has no validation
description: wolfssl_provider.c and kcapi_provider.c each hardcode num_algos as a manual count (24 and 17 respectively). If someone adds/removes an algorithm and forgets to update num_algos, the module silently registers with wrong count. The kernel crypto API still works (null-terminated list), so the bug is invisible in functionality but breaks observability (module log message and monitoring). Counts are currently correct. Recommend: add compile-time assertion or build-time validation.
